info.title: Relo integration API
info.description: Questions, cards and notifications for an app signed in with `relo auth login`. See docs/INTEGRATING.md.

post.description: A one-off alert. Never a question and never progress: use a Live Activity for those.

post.description: Approval, yes/no or a choice of 2-4 options; no typed answers. On a card (presentation=live_activity) the prompt is one line of at most 120 characters and the explanation goes in `detail` (markdown, up to 4,000). expiresInSeconds is capped by the server admin (7 days by default). With `callback`, Relo POSTs the answer signed with Relo-Signature: t=UNIX,v1=HMAC-SHA256(token, "UNIX.BODY") and a stable Relo-Delivery-Id.

get.description: Every settled question this credential asked, oldest first. Each answer carries a cursor; pass the last one as `after` to resume without gaps or repeats. Without `after` or `since` the stream starts now.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: A cursor from an earlier answer.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: An ISO time to start from instead of a cursor.

parameters.name: timeoutSeconds
parameters.description: How long to hold the request open waiting (0-300, default 60).
